commits.subject: feat(agent): add Notification hook for session status detection
commits.body:
Add support for Claude Code's Notification hook to properly detect when
Claude needs user attention (permission requests, input prompts).

Changes:
- Add /api/notification endpoint to receive hook payloads
- Create ~/.247/notification.sh script (auto-generated at startup)
- Configure Notification hook in ~/.claude/settings.json
- Fix heartbeat monitor to allow idle transition after timeout
- Status now properly shows "Permission" instead of always "Working"

Flow: working → notification hook → needs_attention → heartbeat → working

- Add Ralph Loop tab in New Session modal with PromptBuilder
- Add RalphLoopTab, PromptBuilder components and useRalphLoop hook
- Add Ralph Loop config types to shared package
- Add start-claude-ralph WebSocket handler in agent
- Fix terminal remount race condition using stable key ref
- Fix shell character escaping: use [promise] instead of <promise>
- Add ralphConfigRef to avoid stale closure in WebSocket handler
